$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md section 3 - feature scenario for CE-1963 / CE-1964 (ground shaping on a terrain with NO height grid; DESIGN_Ground_Patches_And_Road_Blockage G-14, G-26). The ground's height has no cue, and the ditch's 'no vehicle crosses' area is read from the shape itself, so it held even when the ground was NOT carved - the Ditch Rifle row is what sees the carve: a man STANDING on the shape carries it (SimTransform.Position.2, his surface z). LEFT OUT: the draw panel's tint and hint (rail GroundEffectTests.CE1964_*), the drawn trees of a wood (rail TerrainChunkTreesTests.CE1968_*), the 3-D body of a feature (rail Map3DTests.CE1966_*).
